name: @enzo-interiors/promo-video
description: Enzo Interiors — "new website launching soon" Instagram videos (Remotion)

scripts.render: npm run render:reel && npm run render:feed && npm run render:story && npm run render:stills
scripts.render:reel: node scripts/sync-assets.mjs && remotion render LaunchReel out/enzo-launch-reel-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:feed: node scripts/sync-assets.mjs && remotion render LaunchFeed out/enzo-launch-feed-4x5.mp4
scripts.render:story: node scripts/sync-assets.mjs && remotion render LaunchStory out/enzo-launch-story-9x16.mp4
scripts.render:stills: node scripts/sync-assets.mjs && remotion still ReelCover out/enzo-reel-cover-9x16.png && remotion still FeedPoster out/enzo-feed-poster-4x5.png
